activation.first_release_protocol: one integrate step; source=initial; no sweep or overrides
activation.registration_gate: new immutable bundle/schema IDs, module+observable/resource registrations, semantic+runner+payload dispatch, package data and hashes, old 0.2 resolver/replay regression

physics.model: autonomous conservative identical radial pair potential on all i<j
physics.scope: finite nonperiodic 3D all-free point particles, 2..128; explicit masses and full-step velocities
physics.not_claimed: NVE ensemble sampling, temperature, pressure, ergodicity, or real-material validity

scaling.precision: finite IEEE754 binary64; existing overflow-safe product/sum policy; no silent lower precision

updates: validate drift segment and trial domain; compute F(r_trial)
accept synchronized q/v/force only after structural/domain/finite checks; record diagnostics at every accepted full step
integrator.force_evaluations: n+1 per leg; no trial accepted before whole step validation
integrator.time_grid: t_j=correctly-rounded binary64(j*exact_binary64(leg_dt)); no iterative addition; each halved leg_dt must exactly represent dt/factor. Reject nonfinite/non-increasing grid and unrepresentable/zero SI or reduced half-step.
no_adaptations: no path interpolation as computed physical states
integrator.drift_guard: For each pair d(s)=d0+s*(d1-d0), reject if min_{0<=s<=1}|d(s)| <= min_distance_m. Use scaled/overflow-safe geometry. This only guards the numerical drift path, not a physical collision-time certificate; other AST singularities checked at force evaluations.
integrator.internal_arithmetic: Reduced q=r/L0, u=v/(L0/T0), reduced masses and step; SI update formulas specify the same method. Explicitly require positive representable SI and reduced half-steps for every requested leg, including finest half-step h/8 in refinement mode.

resources.sampling: primary indices {0,s,2s,...<n,n}; F=1+ceil(n/s); require 1<=s<=n. For refinement save each leg only at primary sample times; combined frames=3F. Reserve one additional unsampled terminal-partial frame per requested leg: total reserved=L*(F+1)<=512.
resources.preflight: legs=1 or3; total evaluations=n+1 or7n+3; pair work=C(N,2)*total evaluations; enforce all ceilings before execution. Conservative trajectory bound: reserved_frames*[25*(9N+15)+8N+1024]+65536. Separately count actual original input/provenance and reserved terminal envelope bytes against same32MiB run cap; final exact bytes checked before atomic publish.
resources.wall_limit: Hard supervisor deadline remains authoritative; accepted ceilings do not promise completion.

diagnostics.cadence: every accepted integration step of every leg, never only output samples
diagnostics.angular_momentum: max_j max_component |L_j-L_initial| / J0; about fixed SI origin
diagnostics.center_of_mass: max_j max_component |R_j-(R_initial+V_initial*t_j)| / L0; reported, exact-fixture gate only
diagnostics.numerical_status: pass only if full trajectory completed, finite/domain/drift checks pass and declared E/P/L scaled tolerances pass; failed criterion -> not_converged (not optimizer convergence)
diagnostics.tolerance_timing: Do not reject or adapt a finite step solely because an E/P/L tolerance is exceeded. Finish all requested legs unless hard domain/range/resource/cancel failure; judge aggregate maxima after completion.

refinement.halving_2: independent h,n; h/2,2n; h/4,4n from identical initial phase state to same exact nominal duration; no hidden replacement of primary trajectory
refinement.state_error: max across every primary integer step, particle and q/L0,v/(L0/T0) component: abs(a-b)/(state_atol+state_rtol*max(abs(a),abs(b)))
refinement.pass_rule: coarse(h,h/2) error<=1 AND fine(h/2,h/4) error<=1 AND fine<=coarse; if both exactly zero, finite-step agreement may pass but observed order is indeterminate, not a second-order proof
refinement.comparison_storage: bounded coarse q/v buffers; compare matching integer indices2j/4j, not interpolated sample curves
refinement.refinement_failure: Any failed leg fails full requested operation; completed leg evidence may be partial, no successful final state or downstream promotion.

failure_semantics.invalid_initial_state: fail before any trajectory payload; no invented initial force or zeros
failure_semantics.later_domain_or_range_failure: only last fully synchronized accepted step may be partial; append last accepted frame if not sampled, include it in preflight reserved frame count; never publish half-kick/trial r as state
failure_semantics.resource_or_timeout: explicit failure with requested/limit/observed quantities; no truncation to pass or automatic resampling
failure_semantics.cancellation: existing supervisor semantics; no success after committed cancel; only already committed artifacts retained. Do not promise active child in-memory trajectory survival or checkpoint resume.
failure_semantics.publication: result envelope execution/numerical/resolution/physical axes separate; complete all requested legs before successful state publish; cancelled/failed output never downstream source

status_mapping.success: SUCCEEDED only when all requested legs complete, numerical_status=pass and resolution_status=pass or explicitly not_checked for refinement=none; partial=false; publish final phase state of primary factor1.
status_mapping.tolerance_failure: Any E/P/L criterion failure on any complete leg -> numerical_status=not_converged; any requested resolution criterion failure -> resolution_status=not_converged. Execution=FAILED, partial=true if validated trajectory exists, no successful output state.
status_mapping.hard_failure: Domain/range/structural/resource failure -> FAILED; cancellation -> CANCELLED; overall uncompleted numerical/resolution assessments=not_checked, no successful output state. Existing committed earlier evidence remains separate.

state_and_replay.state_content: ordered ids,masses,positions,full-step velocities,physical time, potential, scales, boundary and min_distance; envelope physical_time must equal content time_s
state_and_replay.hashes: canonical authored request, effective phase state including time, frozen module/solver/schema/registry/resource profile, actual arrays/artifact bytes, implementation/dependency/environment hashes all retained
state_and_replay.initial: starts at explicitly required time0; no live restart from solver data
state_and_replay.static_transfer: not automatic; copying coordinates requires explicit new input with chosen masses and velocities
state_and_replay.replay: old0.2 bundle/implementation hashes never rewritten; current-version execution is a separate new run

implementation_order: extract shared pair force kernel preserving static/relax regression
web integration and visualization after numerical gates
admission_semantics: Strict JSON + finite binary64; unique ordered IDs; all masses/scales/min_distance positive.
Derived force/velocity/mass/momentum/angular scales and reduced masses are finite strictly positive; reduced q/v/min_distance and dt are finite; nonzero-to-zero underflow is an explicit range error.

Every leg SI dt and its half, reduced dt and its half are positive representable; exact dt/factor retained when refining. Conservative arithmetic-domain restriction is declared, not universal physical necessity.

Initial and every force evaluation require all pair distances greater than minimum, AST value and first derivative defined and finite; drift-segment guard is additional. Checker does not execute arbitrary AST physics/domain evaluations.

payload_semantics.legs: Complete operation factors exactly[1] or[1,2,4] in order. Partial is nonempty prefix of started legs with valid initial force, no duplicates or invented unstarted leg.
payload_semantics.particle_arrays: particle_ids and masses exactly match request order; every q/v/F frame has shape[N,3]. No reordering or inferred entries.
payload_semantics.step_counts: leg.requested_steps=factor*primary_n; 0<=completed_steps<=requested_steps; full completion requires equality; aggregate tolerance failure may still have completed_steps=requested_steps.
payload_semantics.force_counts: force_evaluations counts attempted complete-force calls including failed calls; completed_force_evaluations counts calls returning valid q/U/F. Complete finite leg has both=n_leg+1. Partial leg has completed>=completed_steps+1 and attempted>=completed; driftguard failure may occur before next force call.
payload_semantics.frame_indices: For leg factor r, normal sample indices are r*j for primary j in{0,s,2s,...<n,n}, restricted to <=completed_steps. Append completed_steps if not already sampled for partial; reserve this terminal extra beforehand. Indices unique sorted, begin0, endcompleted_steps.
payload_semantics.times: frame.time_s equals correctly-rounded binary64(frame.step_index*exact_binary64(leg_dt)); same common nominal time in refinement; no interpolated or half-step frames.
payload_semantics.none_resolution: mode=none requires status=not_checked and both errors=null.
payload_semantics.refinement_resolution: Completed halving_2 has exactly3 complete legs and numeric coarse/fine errors; pass iff declared pass_rule. Incomplete refinement has status=not_checked and both errors=null. No successful output state on failed execution.
payload_semantics.status: execution/numerical/resolution/physical axes are in common result envelope; physical remainsunvalidated; successful phase state derives only from primary factor1 final frame.
